metric.strong: share of pixels whose largest RGB channel difference exceeds 64 after a 3x3 box blur of both images (ImageDiff)
metric.mean: mean largest RGB channel difference without blur, 0-255
metric.heightDifference: native minus Cordova wrapper height in device pixels (density 2)

rule: a comparison passes when strong <= recorded + margin.strong, mean <= recorded + margin.mean and the height difference <= recorded heightDifference + margin.heightDifference
recordedOn: Robolectric 4.17, SDK 34, native graphics, macOS arm64 and the CI runner; the references are chart-reference/<WxH>/kma-seoul captures; re-recorded 2026-11-08 (AN-08) after the header rows took the WebView's line metrics
why: Residual differences are glyph rasterization (system Roboto versions) and text baselines on whole device pixels in the WebView. The header rows follow the WebView's line boxes (CssMetrics: Roboto and the Korean fallback font, ascent and descent each rounded to device pixels), so the wrappers match at 360 and 384; at 412 the WebView snaps the wrapper's fractional edges to 1 px more. Removing the today line raised strong by 0.0023 at 384x832 opening, which the margin of 0.0015 detects; grey today circles, a 2 dp shift and 16 sp hour labels raised it to 0.022, 0.052 and 0.025.
